moral: Truth can be found with careful observation.

story: One day, two merchants came to Emperor Akbar arguing over a bag of gold coins. Both claimed it was theirs. Akbar asked Birbal to solve the problem. Birbal examined the bag and noticed it smelled like spices. The next day, he asked both merchants about their work. One said he was a spice seller, and the other said he sold clothes. Birbal gave the bag to the spice seller, explaining that the smell proved it belonged to him. Akbar agreed.
